title: unionclef 0.95.53
subtitle: a nether portal from buckets and a lava lake
caption: unionclef 0.95.53: the bucket portal gets built. No diamond pickaxe, a lava lake, two buckets: the bot casts the ten frame blocks, lights it and walks into the nether. Portal lit in 5 of 9 runs (0.95.52: 1 of 8), in 125-155 s. github.com/3ndetz/unionclef/releases/tag/v0.95.53
